_about: One stay ladder, engine E3 (logic wave 3). Each case runs the real bedPrice (the one bed price of every screen) on a real town from stay-places.json and states the tier priced, the units and the cleaning. Owner defaults (2026-11-23): 3, a missing tier falls dorm, private room, 2-star, 3-star and an entire place only last and labelled, a group in entire places books as many places for two as it fills with the cleaning charged per place; 4, children share the parents' room up to 2 children a room and take one bed each in a dorm. 'current' is a regression guard; 'target' fails until E3 is on.

cases.source: A solo dorm request in a town with hostels prices the dorm bed (3 nights at 25)
A-2 and G-6: a solo dorm request in Venice (no hostel) fell to the entire place at 194 a night; owner default 3: dorm, private, 2-star, 3-star, so the 3-star room at 84
A-2: Santorini has no hostel; the ladder reaches the 2-star room at 62 before the entire place at 115
G-6 ladder half: the Explore row (costRow) takes the same ladder, so the card and the planner agree
A-2: an entire place in Gothenburg (no Airbnb) priced the family in a dorm, three beds; the ladder for an entire place goes to the 3-star, one room for 2 + 2
A-2: an Airbnb room where there is no Airbnb falls to the hostel's private room, not a dorm
A-2: a 5-star request where there are none fell to the entire place; owner default 3, a dear request goes 5-star, 4-star, 3-star
A-4: children share the parents' room; owner default 4, up to 2 children in a room; one room, 3 nights at 96
A-4: 2 adults + 1 child book one room, not two
A-4: a room holds 2 children, so three children need a second room
Three adults take two rooms (a double sleeps two adults)
Five adults take three rooms
A single traveller books one room
A-15: children in a dorm get one bed each (owner default 4); two adults and two children are four beds, 4 x 25 x 3 nights; two children sharing one bed was the old half bed
One place for two: cleaning is half a night (stay.fees cleaning_fee_frac_of_night 0.5 x 104)
A-3: four adults book two places for two and each is cleaned; cleaning was charged once (52)
A-3: eight sleepers are four places and four cleanings (4 x 52)
A hostel private room where the town has one is priced as asked
